North Delta condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for apartments (condos) in North Delta was $479,000 in September 2026 (-11.6% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
North Delta condos sold, November 2025 to October 2026

42 condos sold in North Delta with a median price of $488,000 (the middle half sold between $406,000 and $575,750), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $605 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $431 a month.

blocks.text: North Delta: the apartments (condos) benchmark was $479,000 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 11.6%; over three months it fell 5.2%; over the last month it was little changed (-1.3%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 17.4%; over 5 years it was little changed (+1.3%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

faq.a: The middle half of the 42 condos that sold in North Delta went for between $406,000 and $575,750, around a median of $488,000.
